OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be a
            syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional on
            create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2013-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Create-only opt-in acknowledging that this owner deliberately shares a
            household (same last name and address) with an existing owner. When true,
            the same-household duplicate check is skipped; otherwise a matching owner
            causes the create to be rejected with 409.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code, formatted '<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>' where CITY3
                is the upper-cased first three letters of city, LAST3 the upper-cased first
                three letters of lastName and NNNN a per-city 4-digit zero-padded sequence
                (one more than the owners already in that city) assigned at creation.
              type: string
              example: 'SYD-SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable identifier shared by owners who deliberately share a household
                (same last name and address). Assigned when an owner is created with
                'sharesHousehold' true and a matching owner already exists; both the new
                owner and the existing household member(s) carry the same value. Absent
                for owners that do not share a household.
              type: string
              example: 'HH-1A2B3C4D5E6F'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that, at the time this owner was created,
                shared the same firstName and lastName (compared case-insensitively).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>' where YY
                is the last two digits of the registrationDate year.
              type: string
              example: 'SYD-SMI-0007-M26'
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's membership level, from 1 to 3, assigned at creation. Starts
                at 1, plus 1 when an email is present, plus 1 when namesakeCount is 0,
                capped at 3 (level 4 is reserved for tenure).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 3
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The owner's region, derived from city using the fixed city-to-region
                table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD). 'UNKNOWN' when the
                city is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel, derived at read time:
                'EMAIL' when an email is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - EMAIL
                - PHONE
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when more than 80 other owners share this owner's registration
                date (i.e. more than 80 owners had already been created that day),
                otherwise false. Flags a suspiciously high volume of same-day signups.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:

          items:

          maxLength: 255

        city:

          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80

          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20

          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format. Optional on
            create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current date.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2013-01-01'

          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Create-only opt-in acknowledging that this owner deliberately shares a
            household (same last name and address) with an existing owner. When true,
            the same-household duplicate check is skipped; otherwise a matching owner
            causes the create to be rejected with 409.

          example: true

      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-

                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: >-
                The owner's customer code, formatted '<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>' where CITY3
                is the upper-cased first three letters of city, LAST3 the upper-cased first
                three letters of lastName and NNNN a per-city 4-digit zero-padded sequence
                (one more than the owners already in that city) assigned at creation.
              type: string
              example: 'SYD-SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: >-
                A stable identifier shared by owners who deliberately share a household
                (same last name and address). Assigned when an owner is created with
                'sharesHousehold' true and a matching owner already exists; both the new
                owner and the existing household member(s) carry the same value. Absent
                for owners that do not share a household.
              type: string
              example: 'HH-1A2B3C4D5E6F'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that, at the time this owner was created,
                shared the same firstName and lastName (compared case-insensitively).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: >-
                The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>' where YY
                is the last two digits of the registrationDate year.
              type: string
              example: 'SYD-SMI-0007-M26'
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's membership level, from 1 to 3, assigned at creation. Starts
                at 1, plus 1 when an email is present, plus 1 when namesakeCount is 0,
                capped at 3 (level 4 is reserved for tenure).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 3
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The owner's region, derived from city using the fixed city-to-region
                table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD). 'UNKNOWN' when the
                city is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference

                The owner's preferred contact channel, derived at read time:
                'EMAIL' when an email is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              enum:

                - PHONE
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true

              title: Bulk signup warning

                otherwise false. Flags a suspiciously high volume of same-day signups.
              type: boolean
              example: false

            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:

## What I did

Consolidated all owner duplicate detection into a single derived `identityKey = normalizedTelephone + '|' + (email or empty) + '|' + (householdId or empty)`, rejecting a create with **409 only on a whole-key match**, and now **returning** `identityKey` on the owner.

**New files**
- `OwnerIdentityKey.java` — the single source of truth for the key, derived from an owner's stored (already-normalized) telephone, email and householdId.
- `CheckOwnerIdentityUnique.java` — the one duplicate check: compares the new owner's whole `identityKey` against every existing owner's, throwing `DuplicateOwnerException` when equal.
- `DuplicateOwnerException.java` / `DuplicateOwnerExceptionHandler.java` + its escalation YAML — 409 with `{"errors":["identityKey"]}`.

**Changed**
- `owners.POST.yml` — removed the three separate `checkTelephoneUnique` / `checkEmailUnique` / `checkHouseholdUnique` steps and inserted `checkIdentityUnique` **after `assignHousehold`** (so the householdId is part of the key) and **before `save`** (so the not-yet-persisted owner is compared only against existing ones).
- `OwnerMapper.java` — maps `identityKey` via the same `OwnerIdentityKey.of(...)`, so both the create and read responses carry it consistently.
- `openapi.yml` — added the read-only `identityKey` field to the `Owner` schema (so it appears in the generated `OwnerDto`).
- Fixed the now-stale javadoc `{@link}`s in `AssignHousehold` and `TelephoneE164`.

**Removed** the three old check classes plus the `DuplicateTelephone/Email/Household` exceptions, handlers and escalation YAMLs.

## Behaviour change confirmed by tests
Because the telephone is part of the key, two household members (same `householdId`) with different telephones now have **different** keys and are both allowed (Cp11, Cp23); only an exact full-key match — same telephone, email and householdId — is a duplicate (Cp03, Cp10, Cp25, Cp28).

Full suite: **39 tests, 0 failures, 0 errors — BUILD SUCCESS.**
